text: As riots grip Paris after a far-right candidate reaches the presidential run-off, a gang of young Muslim Arab criminals, among them the pregnant Yasmine, [flees the city with stolen cash|trigger|running from trouble]. They head for a family-run inn near the border, where the innkeepers seduce them before [the whole family turns on them|threat|the group turns on you]. Yasmine is [chained in a pigpen|images|ropes, cages and executions], and the patriarch, a still-practising Nazi, toasts [the new blood she will bring to his line|wants|a child to take or have].
